mentions.name: stavrobot
mentions.description: This is an AI personal assistant designed to be secure: it has no access to secrets, uses scoped plugin permissions, and provides isolation. It is presented as a more secure alternative to OpenClaw and pairs with a custom hardware voice note device.
mentions.problem: Existing AI personal assistants like OpenClaw are not actually secure and have access to secrets and broad permissions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I made my own AI personal assistant:

https://github.com/skorokithakis/stavrobot

It's like OpenClaw but actually secure, without access to secrets, with scoped plugin permissions, isolation, etc.
